messages.subject: Behavior of slider
parts:
I would love an option in the slider that, when the slider is referenced in a reactive, will wait until the slider is released (with the mouse button) before updating. I have a few cases where the resulting reaction is to slow for it to smoothly update reactively, but quick enough that it doesn't really motivate the obstructiveness of an action button. Would such a feature be feasible?

Thanks.

messages.subject: Re: Behavior of slider
